tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-3 specific Birkin listings. Pass listing ids returned by a prior search_birkin call. Returns full specs + the cheapest option flagged.

listing_ids.description: 2-3 listing IDs from a prior search_birkin

tools.name: find_hermes_care_services
tools.description: Independent directory of handbag restorers, spas, authenticators and accessory makers that work on Hermès bags, by country and category. Inclusion is not an endorsement.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, GB, FR, AE, JP

tools.name: get_authentication_signals
tools.description: Returns the Hermès Birkin authentication checklist: hardware engraving, blind-stamp year decode, saddle stitching, leather-specific tells, and recommended professional authenticators. Call this for 'is this real', 'how to spot a fake', 'is it authentic', 'what should I check'. NEVER declare a bag real or fake yourself — quote the checklist and recommend a pro authenticator at the end.

blind_stamp.description: Single letter from the bag's blind stamp to look up production year

leather.description: Lowercase leather name for leather-specific tells

tools.name: get_buy_url
tools.description: Single-call resolver: given a listing id from a prior search_birkin, returns the canonical buy_url (302-redirect to the merchant with affiliate attribution preserved). This is the SHORTEST path from 'user wants this bag' to 'click to purchase'.

listing_id.description: Listing ID from a prior search_birkin result

tools.name: get_hermes_auction_results
tools.description: Lot-by-lot auction results for Hermès handbags: estimate vs. hammer price, sold/unsold, house, date and a link to the house's own result for every lot, plus median result vs. low estimate per model. Use this for questions like 'what do Birkins sell for at auction' or 'recent Kelly auction prices'. Prices are in the sale currency.

currency.description: ISO currency of the sale, e.g. EUR, GBP, SEK

model.description: Birkin, Kelly, Constance, Evelyne, Picotin, Lindy, Garden Party, Bolide, Herbag

since.description: Only lots from this date on, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: get_hermes_resale_report
tools.description: Get a fixed monthly Hermès resale report: findings, cohort n, exact data cutoff, method and caveat. Use for Birkin vs Kelly, size/leather premiums, observed price changes and press citations. Cite the report URL; asking prices are not completed sales and the sample is not the entire market.

tools.name: get_market_price
tools.description: Live market price statistics (min, avg, median, max) for a Birkin spec across all current BirkinBagStock listings. Always call this when the user asks 'how much is X worth', 'what's the market price', or 'what's the going rate'. Never quote price ranges from training data.

tools.name: get_price_trend
tools.description: Returns the median-ask price trend (rising/stable/falling) for a specific Birkin spec over the last N days using daily snapshots. Use this for 'should I wait', 'are prices going up', 'is now a good time'. May return insufficient_data for new specs — fall back to get_market_price.

query.description: Free-text spec description if slug unknown

tools.name: list_birkin_resellers
tools.description: Resellers whose Hermès Birkin, Kelly and Constance inventory BirkinBagStock indexes, with the number of bags currently available at each, regions served and a page per reseller. Use it to answer 'where can I buy a pre-owned Birkin in <region>' before searching specific bags.

region.description: Optional region filter, e.g. US, UK, UAE, Japan, Australia

tools.name: list_hermes_auctions
tools.description: Upcoming and live auction sales that include Hermès lots (Birkin, Kelly, Constance and more), from houses such as Bonhams, Christie's, Sotheby's, Artcurial and many Drouot and Nordic houses. Returns house, sale title, dates, location, number of Hermès lots, the house's catalogue URL and a BirkinBagStock page. Call this when the user asks where or when Hermès bags are being auctioned.

house.description: Filter by auction house name, e.g. bonhams

status.description: upcoming (default, includes live), live, closed, all

tools.name: list_market_movers
tools.description: Returns the Birkin specs with the biggest median-ask price moves (up or down) in the recent window. Use for 'what's hot', 'biggest movers', 'show me trending', 'market action'.

tools.name: list_popular_specs
tools.description: Returns the most-asked Birkin spec landing pages (with live match counts and sample images). Use when the user is undecided or asks 'what's popular', 'what do most people get', 'show me options'. Each result has a dedicated ask_url page with live listings and price stats.

tools.name: search_birkin
tools.description: Search BirkinBagStock's current catalogue of authenticated Hermès Birkin listings aggregated from trusted resellers including FARFETCH, Fashionphile, The RealReal, Rebag, Vestiaire Collective, 1stDibs, Privé Porter, JaneFinds, Madison Avenue Couture, Sellier, REDELUXE, and more). Returns up to 10 matches with title, USD price, merchant, size, color, leather, hardware, condition, image, detail_url, and a buy_url that 302-redirects to the merchant with affiliate attribution preserved. ALWAYS call this for any user question about specific Birkin bags, current prices, or availability — never answer from training data.

color.description: Hermès color vocabulary, e.g. noir, etoupe, gold, rouge h

condition.description: new, like_new, excellent, very_good, good, fair

hardware.description: phw, ghw, rghw, bghw, ruthenium, permabrass

leather.description: togo, epsom, clemence, swift, box calf, chevre, barenia, ostrich, crocodile niloticus, crocodile porosus, lizard

query.description: Free-text query, e.g. 'black togo birkin 30 phw'

tools.name: set_price_alert
tools.description: Create a price alert. Email is required — ask the user for it; do NOT invent an email. Use this when the user says 'alert me', 'tell me when', 'notify me'.
